title: CLI Layer — Direct Engine Access from Command Line
description: Build a thin CLI layer over PRISM's 985 engines, enabling direct command-line access without AI/MCP overhead. Direct dispatcher calling (Option B) for zero-latency single-process execution. Priority commands target shop-floor workflows: speed/feed, simulation, quoting, program generation, tool selection, playbook lookup. Includes JSON/table/CSV output modes, stdin piping, and shell completions. Forge-triple: CLI infrastructure engine, 6+ slash commands, 3+ hooks.

phases.title: CLI Infrastructure + Core Framework
phases.description: Set up CLI entry point, argument parsing, output formatting, and the CLIDispatchEngine that routes commands to existing dispatchers.

units.title: Package setup + CLI entry point
units.description: Add commander dependency. Create src/cli/index.ts with shebang. Add 'bin' field to package.json pointing to dist/cli/index.js. Add 'prism' command name. Create build script for CLI bundle (esbuild, separate from MCP server).

units.title: CLIDispatchEngine + output formatters
units.description: Create CLIDispatchEngine that accepts (command, action, params) and routes to the correct dispatcher. Create src/cli/formatters.ts with 4 output modes: json (default, machine-readable), table (human-readable cli-table3), csv (pipe-friendly), compact (minimal). All commands support --format flag.

units.title: Global flags + config + error handling
units.description: Add global flags: --verbose, --quiet, --no-color, --timeout, --config. Create src/cli/config.ts that reads ~/.prism/config.json for defaults (default machine, material, controller, output format). Unified error handler that outputs structured errors in chosen format. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=error, 2=validation fail.

units.title: Stdin piping + streaming
units.description: Support stdin JSON piping: echo '{...}' | prism sf. Detect TTY vs pipe mode. In pipe mode: JSON output, no colors, no progress. In TTY mode: table output, colors, spinners. Support --stdin flag to force stdin reading.
acceptance: Output adapts to pipe vs terminal

phases.title: Priority Commands — Shop Floor Essentials
phases.description: The 8 highest-value CLI commands, each calling existing production engines directly.

units.title: prism sf (speed-feed)
units.description: Speed/feed calculator. Calls SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine.compute(). Args: --material, --tool-diameter, --flutes, --operation (roughing|finishing|drilling), --machine, --optimize (productivity|tool_life|surface_finish|balanced|cost). Output: RPM, feed, Vc, forces, power, tool life, CI95. Shorthand: prism sf aluminum 12mm 4fl roughing.
acceptance: prism sf --material aluminum_6061 --tool-diameter 12 --flutes 4 --operation roughing outputs valid S/F
units.closedReason: VERIFIED-COMPLETE: prism sf CLI command fully built at mcp-server/src/cli/index.ts:83 — .command("sf").alias("speed-feed"), calls speedFeedOrchestratorEngine.compute() (67-point physics), 10 options (material/tool-diameter/flutes/operation/machine/optimize/ap/ae/tool-material/coolant), stdin-pipe + 4 output formats. Envelope status was stale not_started.

units.title: prism sim (simulate)
units.description: G-code simulation. Calls CNCSimulationPipelineEngine. Args: --gcode <file>, --machine, --material, --report. Accepts G-code file path or stdin. Outputs safety analysis, force/thermal/wear per block, cycle time. --report generates full HTML/JSON report.
acceptance: prism sim --gcode program.nc --machine 'Haas VF-2' runs simulation
stdin piping works: cat program.nc | prism sim

units.title: prism quote (estimate)
units.description: Manufacturing quote. Calls QuoteEstimatorEngine.estimate(). Args: --part <json-file>, --quantity, --material, --complexity, --rush, --format. Accepts part JSON or interactive prompts. Outputs cost breakdown, lead time, price breaks, DfM warnings.
acceptance: Price breaks shown for multiple quantities

units.title: prism program (generate CNC program)
units.description: Full CNC program generation. Calls PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.runFullPipelineAsync(). Args: --part <json>, --material, --machine, --controller, --optimize, --output <file>. Generates complete G-code program with setup sheet.
acceptance: prism program --part drawing.json --controller haas outputs G-code
Setup sheet printed to stderr or separate file
Enhanced async pipeline used by default

units.title: prism post (post-process)
units.description: Post-processor pipeline. Calls PostProcessorPipelineEngine.process(). Args: --gcode <file>, --controller, --machine, --aggressiveness, --optimize. Pipe-friendly: cat rough.nc | prism post --controller siemens > optimized.nc.
acceptance: prism post --gcode input.nc --controller fanuc outputs optimized G-code
Piping works: cat in.nc | prism post > out.nc

units.title: prism tool (tool selection + catalog)
units.description: Tool lookup and selection. Calls InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine + ToolCatalogEngine. Subcommands: prism tool search (catalog search), prism tool select (feature-based selection), prism tool magazine (magazine optimizer). Args: --type, --diameter, --material, --manufacturer, --operation.
acceptance: prism tool search --type endmill --diameter 12 lists matching tools
prism tool select --features pocket,hole outputs tool list
prism tool magazine --tools T1,T2,T3 optimizes layout

units.title: prism playbook (best practices)
units.description: Machining playbook advisor. Calls MachiningPlaybookEngine.query(). Args: --operation, --material, --hardness, --issue. Quick rule lookup: prism playbook titanium roughing. Outputs applicable rules with evidence levels and formula references.
acceptance: prism playbook --operation roughing --material titanium outputs rules
Shorthand works: prism playbook titanium roughing
Evidence levels and formula refs shown

units.title: prism calc (quick calculation)
units.description: Direct formula calculator. Routes to calcDispatcher. Args: prism calc <action> [params]. Examples: prism calc kienzle_force --kc1_1 1500 --mc 0.25 --ap 3 --fz 0.1. Lists available actions with prism calc --list. Covers all 2385+ calcDispatcher actions.
acceptance: prism calc taylor_life outputs tool life

phases.title: Batch Operations + Composability
phases.description: Enable batch processing, shell piping, and multi-program workflows.

units.title: Batch mode for all commands
units.description: Add --batch flag that reads newline-delimited JSON from stdin and processes each line as a separate invocation. Output: one JSON result per line (NDJSON). Example: cat parts.ndjson | prism quote --batch --quantity 100 > quotes.ndjson. Parallel execution with --parallel <n> flag.

units.title: Glob processing for file-based commands
units.description: Commands that accept files (sim, post, program) support globs: prism sim *.nc --report. Process all matching files, output individual results + summary. --output-dir for writing results to a directory.

units.title: Pipeline composition helpers
units.description: Add prism pipe subcommand for chaining: prism pipe 'sf aluminum 12mm roughing | program --controller haas | post --controller fanuc'. Internal piping without shell overhead. Also: prism tee for splitting output to file + stdout.
acceptance: prism tee writes to file and stdout

phases.title: Shell Integration + DX
phases.description: Shell completions, REPL mode, and developer experience improvements.

units.title: Shell completions (bash/zsh/fish/powershell)
units.description: Generate shell completion scripts: prism completion bash > ~/.prism/completions.bash. Complete commands, subcommands, flags, and enum values (materials, operations, controllers). Use commander's built-in completion or tabtab.
acceptance: prism completion bash outputs valid bash completion
Works on bash, zsh, fish, powershell

units.title: REPL mode
units.description: Interactive mode: prism repl. Persistent session with history, auto-complete, and context (last result available as $prev). Commands execute immediately. Support .save/.load for session state. Uses readline or inquirer.

units.title: Man pages + help system
units.description: Rich help for every command: prism help sf shows usage, examples, available flags, and sample output. Generate man pages for Unix systems. Include 2-3 real-world examples per command.

phases.title: Forge Triple — Skills + Hooks + Engine
phases.description: Create slash commands for CLI management, hooks for CLI-aware workflows, and the CLIDispatchEngine.

units.title: CLIDispatchEngine (token-saving engine)
units.description: Engine that maps CLI command strings to dispatcher calls with minimal overhead. Maintains a command registry with shorthand aliases. Can generate CLI help text from dispatcher action schemas. Methods: dispatch(cmd, args), listCommands(), generateHelp(cmd), validateArgs(cmd, args).

units.title: Skills: /cli-build, /cli-test, /cli-install
units.description: Create 3 slash commands: /cli-build (build CLI bundle), /cli-test (run CLI-specific tests), /cli-install (npm link for local dev). These enable AI-assisted CLI development workflows.

units.title: Hooks: CLI output validation + auto-format
units.description: Create hooks: (1) pretooluse hook that detects when user is asking for CLI-type output and suggests using prism CLI instead of MCP, (2) posttooluse hook that auto-formats dispatcher output for terminal display when running in CLI mode, (3) hookify rule that warns when MCP is being used for batch operations better suited to CLI.
acceptance: Hook suggests CLI for batch operations
Auto-format hook works in CLI mode
Hookify rule fires on batch patterns

units.title: Integration tests + build verification
units.description: End-to-end tests: spawn CLI process, verify output format, test piping, test batch mode, test all 8 priority commands. Build verification: CLI bundle size check, startup time <500ms, command routing correctness.
